title: accessibility: Standard buttons and radio buttons not in keyboard focus order on macOS
body:
### Wails version family

v2

### Exact Wails version

v2.16.0

### Operating System

macOS

### Description

On a Wails app, standard HTML buttons don't seem to be in keyboard focus order unless I turn on a screen reader (VoiceOver for me), making this an accessibility blocker for keyboard-only users who do not use screen readers, for example a sighted person who has a motor disability making it difficult to use a mouse. I also am seeing this behavior for radio button elements.

### To Reproduce

1. Create the default Wails app
2. Place an HTML text input after the "greet" button
3. Attempt to tab through the UI. Observe that focus order skips over "greet" button, putting the second text input into keyboard focus immediately after the first text input.

### Expected behaviour

HTML buttons and radio buttons should appear in keyboard focus 

### Screenshots

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6688fffb-f2d9-43dd-b745-8f4e197557ed
